sources.entry: arcade - An easy-to-use library for creating 2D arcade games.

summary.one_liner: Arcade is an easy-to-learn Python library for creating 2D video games, built on pyglet and OpenGL.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Arcade as a Python library for building 2D video games, aimed at beginners and at programmers who want to avoid a complex framework. It states that the library is built on top of pyglet and OpenGL. The README links to stable documentation and to a development preview for the next release, though the link targets are missing from this copy. It also points to a gallery of example game jam entries made with Arcade. A citation block (BibTeX-style) credits Paul Vincent Craven. The README gives no concrete API examples or feature list, so specifics beyond these points are not stated here.
use_cases: learning to make 2D games in Python
prototyping 2D games on pyglet and OpenGL
notable: Designed for beginning programmers and easy to learn
Maintainers' main contact channel is a Discord server
Has stable docs plus a development preview track
Community showcase of game jam entries
caveats: README gives no install or run instructions, and several documentation links are empty in this copy
License is not named in the README provided
